Protecting sugar industry
*61. SHRI V. NARAYANASAMY:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
pruned sugar export support for three
schemes looking into dwindled stocks and
bullish prices in the domestic market; and
(b) if so, the measures Government are
taking to protect the sugar industries from
incurring losses?
New trains in Andhra Pradesh
*62. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY: Will the Minister of
RAILWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) whether the State Government of
Andhra Pradesh has sought new trains
connecting Secunderabad and Chennai via
Kurnool, Inter-City Day Express between
Secunderabad and Cuddapah and another
connecting Vijayawada and Chennai via
Guntur; and
(b) if so, the action proposed in this
regard?
Spurious drugs and synthetic milk
†*63. SHRI JANESHWAR MISHRA:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the business
of spurious drugs and synthetic milk is
booming throughout the country;
(b) if so, whether there are any
appropriate laws in this regard;
(c) if so, the punishment provided under
these laws and the details of the convicted
persons during the last three years; and
(d) if not, by when Government would
enact a law?
Opening of hospitals on the pattern of
AIIMS
*64. SHRIMATI VANGA GEETHA:
PROF. M.M. AGARWAL:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether six more institutes like
AIIMS are being planned to be set up in
backward areas;
(b) if so, the details of the places
selected and progress achieved in this regard;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

(c) the details of the funds allotted,
released and actually utilised on the
construction of these hospitals during the
year 2003-04 and till date;
(d) the details of facilities alongwith the
total beds to be provided by the above
hospitals; and
(e) by when, the above hospitals are
likely to be commissioned?
Task Force report on micro irrigation
*65. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that task force on
micro irrigation has submitted its report;
(b) whether it is also a fact that the task
force has recommended for an allocation of
Rs. 10,500 crores in the Tenth Plan and
Rs. 51,000 crores in the Eleventh Plan to
meet the needs of three million hectares of
micro irrigational needs of the country;
(c) if so, whether Government have
studied the report;
(d) whether the mater has been
discussed with the Finance Minister and
the Planning Commission; and
(e) if so, the outcome of the discussions?
Study regarding problems of farming
sector
*66. SHRI MANOJ BHATTA-
CHARYA: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have carried
out any authentic study of the problem
afflicting the farming sector in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) if not, whether Government are
aware of the major bottlenecks impeding
the growth in the agricultural sector; and
(d) if  so, the steps proposed to be taken
to remove them?
CII plan for agricultural reforms
*67. DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether agriculture sector, though
on a fast growth track due to rising private
investment is unlikely to sustain last year’s
double digit growth, as per CII assessment;
(b) whether agriculture sector still faces
many hurdles such as poor productivity,
falling water levels, expensive credit, a
distorted market and unfriendly private
investment climate;
(c) if so, whether CII has come out with
a five point plan calling for agriculture
reforms and increased private investment
to put India on a higher growth net;
(d) if so, whether Government have
considered the five point plan; and
(e) if so, the steps being taken to
implement them?
Computerised reservation facility to
encourage tourism
†*68. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will
the Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government propose to
provide the computerized reservation
facility in cities in the country having
importance from the tourism point of view;
and
(b) if so, the names of cities in
Uttaranchal where computerised

provided, keeping in view of the

 Task Force on Bio-technological
applications in agriculture
80. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Task Force on
application of Bio-technology in agri-
culture recommended for Constitution of
an autonomous National Bio-technology
Regulatory Authority for promoting and
monitoring the use of Bio-technology in
agriculture;
(b) if so, the major recommendations
made by the Task Force;
(c) whether the Task Force also
suggested for a single-window clearance for
new genetically-modified varieties; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
 Investment in agriculture
81. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether there is decline in public
investment in agriculture; and
(b) if so, the action taken for more
investment to revive growth in agriculture?
Availability of seeds
82. SHRIMATI VANGA GEETHA :
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state the action taken to provide
reliable and quality seeds to farmers to
ensure that their production do not fall?
Special steps for increasing paddy
production
†83. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
take any special steps to increase paddy
production in the country; and
(b) if so, the details thereof and by when
such steps would be taken?
KVKs in Uttaranchal
†84. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) the names of the districts in
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

22
server1\session_june_2004\918rs.pm6.5 22
Uttaranchal where Krishi Vigyan Kendras
are proposed to be set up in the year
2004-2005;
(b) whether the places for setting up of
these Kendras have been identified; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Food grain out put
85. SHRI R.P. GOENKA: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the food-
grain output during 2003-2004 is expected
to be around 211 million tonnes, falling far
short of the estimated target of 220 million
tonnes;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) the steps being taken to achieve
higher targets and/or check any decline in
food output?
Making agriculture remunerative
†86. SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that agriculture
has turned into a non-profitable industry
and agriculturists are committing suicides
as they are not able to repay the loans;
(b) if not, the assessment of
Government in this regard; and
(c) the rapid and long term measures
decided by Government for making
agriculture a profitable industry?
Emphasis on cash crops
†87. SHRI JANESHWAR MISHRA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the farmers
have given emphasis on cash crops instead
of conventional grains on a large scale in
several areas of the country in the last few
years;
(b) if so, whether Government have
conducted any survey to ascertain the area
of land brought under cash crops during
the last ten years; and
(c) if so, the details thereof, State-wise?
Dependency on rain water for
irrigation
†88. SHRI RAM JETHMALANI: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that around 70
per cent of agriculture in the country is
dependent on monsoon and non-monsoon
rains for irrigation;
(b) if so, whether it is also a fact that
agro-industry has also become uncertain
and non-profitable as a result of uncertain
availability of rain-water;
(c) if not, the reaction of Government
thereto; and
(d) the time bound plan of Government
to get rid of this uncertainty?
Scheme for increasing oil seed
production in Chhattisgarh
†89. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether any scheme to increase the
oil seed production has been formulated
by Government; and
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

(b) if so, the details thereof and the
measures being taken by Government for
increasing the oil seed production in
Chhattisgarh?
Distress of farmers in Andhra
 Pradesh
90. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Andhra Pradesh
Government has apprised the Union
Government about the distress of farmers
in Andhra Pradesh;
(b) if so, the details of assurances given
for assistance in this regard; and
(c) the action taken to clear the pending
drought relief assistance early?
